reviews.title: Great for Establishing Prayer Discipline and Learning
reviews.text:
This app is fantastic! It’s got well known voice actors and scholars to do the content. The content, albeit prayers, Liturgical readings, daily Gospels, OCIA supplementals, Holy Rosary, music, sleep aids, etc. it’s got it and it’s get it in spades. The ability to establish a routine has been paramount in not only establishing a daily prayer regiment and discipline in my life but to learn the prayers more fully and meditations. 

My one nitpick that I’ve ran into has been very limited Divine Hours prayers to only at night. That is a very big ask so it’s by no means a deal breaker—getting a voice actors on board with that just sounds expensive so, I get it, but I would love to see it in the future!

reviews.title: Perfect for Catholics in today’s world
reviews.text:
It has definitely helped me focus more on my prayer life. I especially love that you can start prayer campaigns so you can remember to pray for others, and others can pray for you. 
It’s usually hard for me to remind myself how important it is to pray with how busy and demanding a persons life is nowadays, as well as all having the distractions of technology and social media. But when I have a notification appear that it’s time to pray, stopping to pray for even just 5 minutes makes a difference in someone’s life. 
Also, having the feature where a daily quote or Bible verse appears on your lock screen every day has helped to keep my focus on God throughout the day. 
Highly suggest this app! God Bless!

reviews.title: Faith🙏🏻💜🙏🏻
reviews.text:
Hallow is a wonderful application for your phone. It is probably the most important app for your/my phone.
It helps increase and strengthen your faith & helps guide you to focus on what’s most important, despite the many distractions in our daily lives. May God bless you and yours & us all.
Thank you Hallow!

reviews.title: Returning To My Faith
reviews.text: With the Hallow app, I am diving right back into my Catholic faith. Returning to Jesus and spreading the Word of God has turned into my spiritual passion. Thank you and God Bless.

reviews.title: AI being used in the app
reviews.text: I really enjoyed Hallow up for about a year. It really helped me get into a routine of prayer. But since they started to incorporate AI within the app I decided to cancel my subscription especially after Pope Leo’s disapproval of AI.

reviews.title: My favorite prayer app!
reviews.text: I can’t emphasize enough how much this app has helped and changed my life- the prayers are amazing, the music, devotionals, everything!! But what has helped me SO MUCH, is their option to talk with their Catholic AI. Obviously, talking with a Catholic priest is best if you can and have access to them, but I have had so many questions about the church over the years that their ai has answered, because it is fully integrated in Catholic teaching- citing the Bible, the catechism, etc. And it has a perspective that other AIs just can’t compete with. It has helped me SO MUCH in my faith. So many questions answered, and consolations given. Please, please download this app!!
